segments.name: Natural Gas Gathering and Processing
segments.description: Gathers, compresses, treats, processes and markets raw natural gas for producers in the Rocky Mountain, Mid-Continent and Permian Basin regions.
segments.evidence: In our Natural Gas Gathering and Processing segment, raw natural gas is typically gathered at the wellhead, compressed and transported through pipelines to our processing facilities.

segments.name: Natural Gas Liquids
segments.description: Gathers, treats, fractionates and transports NGLs and stores, markets and distributes Purity NGLs for producers and other customers.
segments.evidence: our Natural Gas Liquids segment gathers, treats, fractionates and transports NGLs and stores, markets and distributes Purity NGLs

segments.name: Natural Gas Pipelines
segments.description: Transports, stores and markets natural gas under long-term, firm fee-based contracts across its interstate pipeline network.
segments.evidence: our Natural Gas Pipelines segment transports, stores and markets natural gas

segments.name: Refined Products and Crude
segments.description: Gathers, transports, stores, distributes, blends and markets Refined Products and crude oil for refiners and other customers.
segments.evidence: our Refined Products and Crude segment gathers, transports, stores, distributes, blends and markets Refined Products and crude oil

revenueModel.text: Producers and other customers pay primarily fee-based charges for gathering, processing, fractionation, transportation and storage, with additional earnings from commodity sales and exchange services.
revenueModel.evidence: Each of our four reportable segments are primarily fee-based, and our consolidated earnings were approximately 90% fee-based in 2025.

changes.text: In 2024, we sold three of our wholly owned interstate natural gas pipeline systems to DT Midstream, Inc., reducing the Natural Gas Pipelines segment.
changes.evidence: Included a gain of $ 227 million for the Natural Gas Pipelines segment related to the sale of three of our wholly owned interstate natural gas pipeline systems to DT Midstream, Inc.
